inputHtml:
The field has drifted far from its roots.1You can pick any recent paper and have no idea what is going on.

Philosophy is often viewed as a science, which leads to misalignment.2The most common areas where this occurs are analytic philosophy and continental philosophy.

In technical terms, facts and values are orthogonal.3Orthogonal means they run independent of one another.

expected.contentMarkdown:
The field has drifted far from its roots.[^1]

Philosophy is often viewed as a science, which leads to misalignment.[^2]

In technical terms, facts and values are orthogonal.[^3]

[^1]: You can pick any recent paper and have no idea what is going on.

[^2]: The most common areas where this occurs are [analytic philosophy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Analytic_philosophy) and [continental philosophy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Continental_philosophy).

[^3]: Orthogonal means they run independent of one another.
